There’s a bunch of policemen walking straight towards us! What’s happening?
You: W-What’s going on {f_botName}?! Are they coming to get us?!
Bot: Calm down. 
You: Did someone report us?!
Bot: That’s not very likely, but if you don’t stop freaking out they might take notice.
Bot: For now we should take a turn, just to be safe…
